organization.notes: 2016 is Kandra Labs formation; original product startup founded 2012. In 2026 independent nonprofit Zulip Foundation became steward and fully owns Kandra Labs. NSF grants and Google Summer of Code support are not equity investors; no VC funding stated in history.

pricingTiers.name: Self-hosted Free
pricingTiers.notes: No recurring license charge for this core scope; infrastructure and optional services separate.
No explicitly highlighted popular plan verified in the reviewed official offer. No inferred designation.

pricingTiers.name: Self-hosted Business
pricingTiers.notes: All software features remain open source. $6.67 annual-billed monthly ×12=$80.04; $8 month-to-month; temporary $20/month first-year promotion excluded.

pricingTiers.name: Self-hosted Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Contact sales. All Zulip software features included in Free; vendor mobile notification relay differs.

moats.claim: Topic-based discussion habits and accumulated organized history create adoption-specific switching costs.

productReasons.claim: Topic-based threading keeps parallel discussions navigable within channels.
Public-access channels can expose selected discussions to readers without accounts.
Granular groups, guest permissions and searchable history support organized communities.

sponsorship.notes: No separate corporate sponsor verified in reviewed project sources; accountable business steward included.

requirements.component: Dedicated supported Linux VM or server; nginx

requirements.condition: Official Docker alternative to native installer

resources.cpu: 1 CPU small installations; 2 CPU for 100+ users
resources.memory: 2 GB minimum with 2 GB swap under 5 GB; 4 GB for 100+ users
resources.storage: 10 GB free (~25 GB total including OS)
resources.notes: Dedicated server recommended; outgoing email credentials required.

selfHosting.notes: Documented default deployment path; optional services are separate from core runtime. No unverified backend alternatives asserted.

oneClickInstall.notes: Reviewed official installation guide. Manual packages, build steps and Compose recipes are not treated as one-click. No distinct officially linked template verified.

serviceLimitations: Vendor-operated mobile push service for commercial organizations above 10 users requires a paid self-hosted plan; eligible communities can receive it free.
classificationReason: All self-hosted software features included in every plan; no enterprise code tier. A applies to software, with separately priced vendor push relay disclosed.

health.rsx: Quick analysis: 6.5/10; balanced policy passed. Automated repository signals; not a version-specific security audit.
